title: A Model Context Protocol Server for Quantum Execution in Hybrid Quantum-HPC Environments
summary: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into scientific research is accelerating the realization of autonomous ``AI Scientists.'' While recent advancements have empowered AI to formulate hypotheses and design experiments, a critical gap remains in the execution of these tasks, particularly in the domain of quantum computing (QC). Executing quantum algorithms requires not only generating code but also managing complex computational resources such as QPUs and high-performance computing (HPC) clusters. In this paper, we propose an AI-driven framework specifically designed to bridge this…
